messages:
hana_marketing: Quick sync on KiteWave case study. We have the audio + transcript and the signed release. Need final quote permissions + legal OK by Thu EOD to hit next Tue publish.

rebecca_cs: Customer approved two short quotes but asked to avoid naming cloud providers and to remove any revenue or contract mentions. Attribution: 'L. Ortega, CTO'. Signed release attached.

mike_pm: Benchmarks summary: steady-state throughput ~4x vs their previous infra; p95 latency fell from ~500ms to ~180ms on typical 1k-token sessions. I'll prepare a short methods note for the appendix.

yara_design: I'll draft hero art and a stat card. Which logo variant? KiteWave sent horizontal and stacked; they prefer horizontal.

tomas_growth: I'll draft headline + three social variants tonight. Any restrictions on percent language?

legal_bot: Confirmed: redact internal hostnames, S3 paths, and contract numbers. Customer release prohibits mention of contract length or ARR. They approved the exact quote text in the signed PDF, which must be used verbatim. Distribution: NA/EU only; APAC requires separate consent.

hana_marketing: Proposed headlines: 1) "How KiteWave scaled real-time inference with Redwood" 2) "KiteWave sees nearly 4x throughput on Redwood" 3) "Predictable, lower-cost inference for KiteWave" Thoughts?

rebecca_cs: Customer asked to soften #3 to "significantly lower inference costs" instead of a claim like 'lower-cost' alone. They did not sign off on explicit percent cost claims.

tomas_growth: Updated social lines: A) "KiteWave scales realtime features with Redwood (nearly 4x throughput)" B) "KiteWave reduces p95 latency from ~500ms to ~180ms" C) "Redwood helped KiteWave make inference predictable and significantly lower cost" Which should be primary?

hana_marketing: Use C for paid, B for organic, A as an experiment. Make sure the quote in the header matches the signed wording.

mike_pm: Methods blurb ready: compared prior mixed-host setup to Redwood Dedicated under steady-load replay; traces anonymized; CSV uploaded to sanitized folder.

s3bot: Reminder: sanitized assets must be placed under `s3://redwood-marketing/kitewave/sanitized/2026-04-02/`. PR scanner will block if internal hostnames remain.

yara_design: Final assets uploaded to `design/marketing/kitewave-package-v1.zip`. Left placeholder for the exact pull quote.

rebecca_cs: Customer signed off on the final copy and asked to coordinate publish with their press window next Wed 8am PT. They requested we not publish earlier. Signed release stored in the PR.

hana_marketing: OK locking calendar: internal review by Tue 2pm PT, publish Wed 8am PT per customer. I'll open the PR and tag reviewers. Thanks team :sparkles:

legal_bot: All clear to publish in NA/EU with the approved quote and sanitized assets. Keep signed PDF in PR for records.
